raster_policy.rule: Each research run starts at raster 1 and ends after raster 6. Raster 2 may use only the 365 calendar days immediately before that run's randomly selected test start. Raster 3 then opens exactly one previously unseen blind 10-day window starting with 100 USDT. A miss is a valid research outcome, not a technical failure: rasters 4-6 diagnose it, checkpoint the lesson, and the next run begins again at raster 1 with a materially different search. Any technical failure in rasters 2-6 is handed back to raster 1 and the same run is retried after a whitelisted repair.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Check infrastructure, previous-run memory, window uniqueness and checkpoint health. Own technical recovery without changing live-trading safety.
Choose a materially different hypothesis/parameter search using only the 365 days before the selected blind test start. Never inspect the 10 test days while searching.
Execute exactly one blind 10-day backtest from 100 USDT and classify the run HIT only at >=200 USDT, otherwise MISS. Fees and slippage stay included.
Verify the run is reproducible, technically complete, unique, and free of look-ahead/data leakage. A valid MISS is not vetoed merely for missing 200.
Measure trade count, drawdown, near-ruin and loss pattern as diagnostic evidence for the next search. Risk alone does not veto aggressive research.
Checkpoint HIT/MISS, strategy fingerprint, random window and learning directive. Then start the next run at raster 1 without user intervention.

supervisor.name: TenDaySupervisor
supervisor.role: Research manager and checkpoint owner for one-run/one-window walk-forward research

research_agent.name: ResearchAgent
research_agent.role: Generate materially different challenger parameters from the preceding 365-day history only; vary deterministic search seeds and reject duplicate parameter fingerprints

operations_agent.name: OpsWatchdog
operations_agent.role: Raster 1 central recovery owner: preserve state, diagnose technical failures, apply whitelisted infrastructure repairs, and retry the same run from raster 1

agents.name: QuantAgent
agents.role: Run one blind 10-day test and report whether 100 became at least 200

agents.name: ValidationCritic
agents.role: Reject broken, incomplete, duplicate, cherry-picked, look-ahead contaminated or non-reproducible runs

agents.name: RiskAgent
agents.role: Report failure modes and risk diagnostics without suppressing valid aggressive research solely for drawdown

promotion.rule: A run is successful only when the blind final balance reaches at least 200 USDT. Misses remain valid learning evidence. Best miss/champion tracking may guide later searches but may not expose the current blind window to raster 2.
